correctness.rationale: From the CTMC transition matrix derived P=da[2-x-xy-d(1-x)(a+(1-a)y)] with x=exp(-gt1), y=exp(-g(t2-t1)); it agrees when tests coincide because errors, not occupancies, are independent. ∂P/∂t2=dag y[x+d(1-x)(1-a)]>0 forces t2=H. Setting h=exp(-gH), the x objective is a constant minus (1-da)x - d(1-a)h/x, strictly concave. Its interior x=sqrt(rh) is feasible exactly when H>=H_c; otherwise boundary t1=H. The completed-square gap equals da(1-da)(max(0,sqrt(r)-sqrt h))². All parameters and d=1 boundary reviewed. Inspected the standard-library checker and performed separate numerical transition-matrix/grid and gain checks; only calculus establishes continuum optimum.
